tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: The categories of KAYQ (banks, stores, travel, IT, health...) and the topics inside each (car rental, job sites, hotels...), with how many websites each holds and its page. Use the slugs with search_websites and most_visited.

tools.name: most_visited
tools.description: The websites KAYQ visitors opened most in the last 30 days, overall or in one category, with the number of visits.

tools.name: website_status
tools.description: Whether a listed website answered KAYQ's latest check, its response time, and the share of good answers over 24 hours and 7 days. KAYQ checks the most visited websites every hour and the others once a day, from a server in Europe.
